test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

_TU_T_TT_ _ TU
solution:
Given : _TU_T_TT_ _ TU

By checking options :

 
• UTUTU → __U__TU__T__T__U__TT__T__ __U__ TU → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• TTUUT → __**T**__TU__**T**__T__**U**__TT__**U**__ __**T**__ TU → (It follows the pattern of : TTU - TTU - TTU - TTU)
 
• UUTUU → __U__TU__U__T__T__TT__U__ __U__ TU → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• TUTUU → __T__TU__U__T__T__TT__U__ __U__ TU → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

Hence, "**TTUUT**" is the correct answer.
